references_policy: Only approved S1-L5 house style anchors used. No references from unapproved parallel entries or _rejects.

blocks.style: Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
blocks.cleanup: Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
blocks.negative: No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
blocks.render: Rendering: unmistakably hand-drawn 2D coloured comic background, crisp inked contours and a few large opaque two-tone cel shadow planes on concrete and buildings. Matte stone, flat slate-blue water broken by deliberate drawn wave contours. Fully drawn establishing detail, no procedural microtexture or photoreal water, no 3D architectural rendering. The attached image is an approved house-style anchor only; do not depict its character or fortress setting. No central cast.
blocks.geo: Shared geography: a 1 km gently curving concrete breakwater, 6 m wide walkway, 0.9 m seaward parapet, car-sized grey tetrapods on the exposed seaward side and calm fishing harbour on its sheltered side. One red cylindrical lighthouse 12 m tall at the outer end. At the landward end: a broad single-storey fish market with blue-grey corrugated roof, an orange tarp food tent on its waterfront edge, a concrete pier and sea wall, a slender steel lattice harbour floodlight tower 25 m tall. The market and light tower lie about 200 m landward of the combat neck. Landward the Busan hillside city has low buildings and a few tall apartment towers. Unbranded small fishing boats on the sheltered water; no signage lettering.
blocks.neckcam: NECK VIEW CAMERA LOCK: high oblique camera about 18 m above the exposed sea, looking landward diagonally along the breakwater, horizon at the upper fifth. Composition: bottom-left foreground is the 6 m walkway; it recedes diagonally to the central neck at picture centre and then turns to the market's sea-wall pier at upper left. Continuous low seaward parapet follows the walkway's RIGHT edge; grey tetrapods below it occupy the LOWER-RIGHT; exposed open sea fills the RIGHT half. Sheltered harbour basin and small moored boats are LEFT of the walkway. Market roof, orange tent, sea wall and concrete pier are at UPPER-LEFT, visually about 200 m behind the central neck. A 25 m steel lattice harbour light tower stands on that pier at left of centre, with a ladder and square floodlight platform. It rises ABOVE this 18 m camera's horizon: the platform is much higher than the low market roof. Keep the fixed buildings, shore shape and tower in these positions in each neck view. The lighthouse is 800 m seaward, behind the camera and OUT OF FRAME. Concrete walkway no stairs, no highway; the old round storm-drain outlet is low in the seaward masonry near the neck.
